title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 3, section 53 (De Courcey Island)
heading: De Courcey Island
sourceText:
Schedule 3 No Shooting or Hunting Areas (Section 4)
De Courcey Island
53 That portion of M.U. 1-1 in the Strait of Georgia which is contained within the following described boundary: The mean low water mark of De Courcey Island. [en. B.C. Reg. 205/94, s. 7; am. B.C. Reg. 190/96, s. 3 (b).]
sourceVersion: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026
